description: Machine-readable input manifest for CUMCM benchmark problems. Every problem statement has been recovered from at least 2 independent sources and cross-verified.

problems.title: 板凳龙闹元宵
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) PDF repost by 哈尔滨信息工程学院基础部, (2) CSDN blog by weixin_66547608. Both contain identical problem text with all 5 sub-questions, 223节板凳, 55cm螺距, 9m调头空间, 1.7m盘出螺距, 2m/s速度上限. Previous input examples/problems/cumcm2024A.txt was INCORRECT (contained 防空导弹拦截弹道目标, which is actually 2025_A). P0 contamination resolved.
problems.attachment_note: result1.xlsx, result2.xlsx, result4.xlsx templates; figures 1-5 referenced but not embedded in text

problems.title: 古代玻璃制品的成分分析与鉴别
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) CSDN blog by 2403_87108415 with full 原题再现, (2) DAMO开发者矩阵 article with identical 原题再现. Both contain 4 sub-questions, 高钾/铅钡玻璃 classification, 85%-105% valid data range, 3 attachment forms. Official讲评 by 北京大学邓明华 on dxs.moe.gov.cn confirms title and scope.
problems.attachment_note: 表单1 玻璃文物基本信息, 表单2 已分类化学成分比例, 表单3 未分类化学成分比例

problems.title: 穿越沙漠
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) CSDN blog by gzn00417 with full problem text, (2) gooseeker forum post containing full 2020 problem set. Both contain identical game rules (8 rules), 3 main questions with multi-player sub-questions, 6 levels (关卡). Official讲评 by 浙江大学谈之奕 on dxs.moe.gov.cn confirms title.
problems.attachment_note: 6关地图与参数数据, Result.xlsx模板. Some numeric parameters (k, n, base consumption) in original are given via attachment data tables not fully captured in text.

problems.title: 高温作业专用服装设计
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) gooseeker forum full 2018 problem set, (2) dxs.moe.gov.cn official paper PDF (problem restatement). Both contain 3 sub-questions, 4-layer model (I/II/III fabric + IV air gap), 37°C假人, 75°C/65°C/80°C scenarios, 47°C/44°C burn thresholds. Official problem PDF also available at cos cloud mirror.
problems.attachment_note: 附件1 专用服装材料参数值, 附件2 假人皮肤外侧测量温度

problems.title: 机场的出租车问题
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) 163.com article with full 2019 problem set (A/B/C/D/E), (2) BNUZ courseware PDF containing 2019_C problem text. Both contain 4 sub-questions, 蓄车池/乘车区 setup, choice A/B for drivers, 2-lane 上车点 optimization, 优先权 scheme. Official讲评 by 韩中庚 on dxs.moe.gov.cn confirms title and scope.
problems.attachment_note: Problem 2 requires teams to collect their own airport/taxi data; no official data attachment.

problems.title: 智能RGV的动态调度策略
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) CSDN blog by qq_40307529 with full problem text incl. 3 scenarios (single/two-process, 1% fault), task 1+2, Table 1 (3 data groups), 8-hour shift; (2) mcm.edu.cn official review page confirms title and scope (2018 undergraduate group B '智能RGV的动态调度策略').
problems.attachment_note: 附件1 智能加工系统示意图（图1）；附件2 EXCEL结果表（3个工作表，对应3组系统作业参数数据，需填写调度策略与作业效率）

problems.title: “拍照赚钱”的任务定价
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources: (1) 长治学院数学系存档 (sxx.czc.edu.cn) with full 4 sub-questions and 3 attachments; (2) 中国大学生在线 official problem download page (dxs.moe.gov.cn CUMCM2017Problems.rar). Both match: pricing rules, completion (1/0), member credit/booking limit, pack publishing.
problems.attachment_note: 附件一 已结束项目任务数据（位置/定价/完成情况）；附件二 会员信息数据（位置/信誉值/开始预订时间/预订限额）；附件三 新项目任务数据（仅位置信息）

problems.title: 交巡警服务平台的设置与调度
problems.verification_notes: Cross-verified against 2 independent sources, text word-for-word identical: (1) 中国大学生在线 official problem page (dxs.moe.gov.cn); (2) 新乡学院数学与统计学院存档 (sx.xxu.edu.cn). Both contain Q1(管辖分配/13要道封锁/新增2-5平台), Q2(全市合理性/P32围堵), attachments 1-2, figure legend notes.
problems.attachment_note: 附件1 A区与全市六区交通网络与平台设置示意图（附图1 A区、附图2 全市）；附件2 全市六区交通网络与平台设置相关数据表（5个工作表）

paper_format_standards.publisher: 全国大学生数学建模竞赛组委会

key_findings.page_limit: 正文不超过30页（2026修订稿硬上限）；2023/2024版为'尽量控制在20页以内'（软目标）
key_findings.abstract: 第三页摘要专用页，含标题和关键词，不超过一页，无需翻译成英文
key_findings.anonymity: 论文任何地方不能有参赛者身份和学校赛区信息
key_findings.appendix: 附录页数不限，必须包含全部可运行源程序代码
key_findings.references: 所有引用必须按科技论文规范列出参考文献并在正文标注
key_findings.submission: 电子版PDF或Word，不超过20MB，第一页必须为摘要页

evaluation_criteria.publisher: 全国大学生数学建模竞赛组委会 (谢金星)
four_criteria: 假设的合理性 (reasonability of model assumptions)
建模的创造性 (creativity/innovation of the model)
结果的正确性 (correctness of the solutions)
文字表述的清晰程度 (readability of the presentation)
